decisive_items: Right eye: focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posterior choroid with larval sections
Left eye: focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posteronasal choroid
Coiled, incompletely sectioned filariform larva within a medium-caliber artery
response.rationale: Ocular larval sections with eosinophilic choroiditis are pathognomonic for ocular larva migrans, whereas disseminated aspergillosis explicitly lacks ocular involvement and hyper-IgE syndrome is a predisposing condition, not the acute diagnosis.

rejected.why: Autopsy states disseminated aspergillosis and candidiasis without ocular involvement; BAL findings are non-specific and contradicted by ocular larval evidence.
Hyper-IgE syndrome is a background immunodeficiency, not the cause of the ocular larval infiltrates.
